en-US.title: peri: the menopause record
en-US.subtitle: Ledger, findings, dossier
en-US.description:
peri is a record, not a companion. It keeps a ledger of what happened and when (a hot flash at 14:30, awake at 03:12), writes one finding a day from that ledger, and files everything into a dossier for your next appointment. Private, on this device, no account.

THE PAGE
Every day has a page. One tap files a moment with the time; severity can be added afterwards. Dictate a line and peri files it against its own vocabulary. Close the day with one word and the ledger does the rest.

THE NIGHT DESK
Between 22:00 and 06:00 the page turns black and quiet: three large targets (Woke, Night sweat, Can’t sleep) and a two-minute wind-down. Log it and go back to bed.

THE FINDING
Each day peri reads the record and writes what it sees in plain words: when your flashes cluster, when you wake, what follows a broken night, what changed since a treatment changed. One day is a note; a week of the same shape is a finding, numbered and dated.

THE DOSSIER (peri Pro)
Seven numbered sections for the visit: where you are, findings, treatments and their changes with before-and-after, questions, evidence pinned from the index, what was agreed after the visit, and your opening statement. Export the one-page brief as a PDF, rehearse the opening out loud, and keep the treatment check-ins.

THE INDEX
Fifteen reviewed chapters on menopause, treatments, sleep, mood, sexual health, bones and screening, with nine tools (breathing, questionnaires, protein, waist, trigger trials). One search box also matches your own ledger.

FREE AND PRO
The page, the ledger, the night desk, the finding of the day, the index and the first-page letter are free, with no account. peri Pro, an auto-renewable monthly or annual subscription, unlocks the dossier, the one-page brief, the treatment check-ins and the rehearsal. The price is shown before purchase, payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation, and the subscription renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple ID subscription settings.

OPTIONAL APPLE HEALTH SUMMARY
When you choose to connect, peri reads steps, sleep and the latest body weight on-device for the brief. Read-only, never in the background, never written back.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your record stays on your device, encrypted with a device-bound key, with Face ID App Lock and password-protected backups. No account, no cloud health database, no sale of personal data, no third-party advertising; health entries never reach analytics or attribution services.

Privacy Policy: https://menlopass.vercel.app/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://menlopass.vercel.app/terms.html

peri provides general health education and self-tracking. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, prescribe, or replace care from a qualified clinician.
en-US.releaseNotes:
peri 2.0 is a new app on the same record.

• Three surfaces: Today, Dossier, Index
• A timestamped ledger instead of a daily form; one tap logs a moment
• One finding a day, written from your record
• A night desk between 22:00 and 06:00
• The first page is a letter with blanks, not a wizard
• The page, the ledger and the finding are free; the dossier and the brief are peri Pro
• New type, new icon, no mascot

Your existing record carries over unchanged.
en-US.promoText: A ledger of what happened, one finding a day, and a dossier for the appointment. Private, on-device, no account.
